info.title: Guilty Hole ～ Room of Guilty Pleasure
info.synopsis: Il professor Sasaki, stanco e sopraffatto dal lavoro, una notte resta sorpreso da un evento inspiegabile: gli armadietti degli studenti si trasformano in misteriosi pannelli di scelta. Per gioco seleziona una ragazza che cattura la sua attenzione, convinto di trovarsi in un sogno. Ma poco dopo lei appare davvero in aula, lo rimprovera con tono aspro, mentre nei suoi occhi traspare un misto di imbarazzo e desiderio. Da quel momento Sasaki viene trascinato in un rapporto ambiguo e proibito, dove il confine tra realtà e fantasia si fa sempre più sottile.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Room of Guilty Pleasure
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Sasaki, a teacher who works overtime and gets dissed by his students, hears a mysterious announcement in school at midnight. The voice welcomes him to the Room of Guilty Pleasure, where he can pick any student he likes. Assuming that it's just a dream from the situation spread out before him, Sasaki picks one student on a whim. Led by the announcement, he enters a classroom where his sassy student, Mai Hoshino, is waiting for him, looking embarrassed...

episodes.title: Would You Like to Request a Girl With Glasses?
episodes.synopsis: After finishing his supplementary classes, Sasaki Mamoru works overtime until late at night. He is dozing off when the bell rings and wakes up, only to find himself face to face with "Guilty Hole" once again. "Which girl would you like to go with today?" Sasaki asks nervously, but chooses Takajo Makoto, the class representative. In response to Sasaki's sincerity, Takajo says, "As a thank you for listening to my advice..." and begins to button her uniform.

episodes.title: Congratulations on Unlocking the Option
episodes.synopsis: "Congratulations on unlocking the option! We have a reverse nomination today." Sasaki Mamoru can't hide his confusion as a different message than usual comes on the air. Light spills out from his Guilty Hall membership card, and he is transported to the audiovisual room. Waiting for him there is a beaming Hojo Makoto. The letters NN are written on the blackboard. This is a dream world. As his student Hojo stares at him, Sasaki, his homeroom teacher, can no longer contain himself...

episodes.title: Would You Like a Dark-Skinned Gyaru?
episodes.synopsis: While being concerned about a certain student of his, the exhausted Mamoru Sasaki was dozing off. He finds that he had fallen asleep as the usual announcement from Guilty Hole welcomes him yet again to the dream dimension. In the nurse's office, Sasaki gets a massage from Aya Hinata, who tells him to loosen up. As he is moved to tears by her kind words, she gently hugs him...

episodes.title: A Delivery from Guilty Hole!
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Sasaki gets a notification from Guilty Hole while asleep in bed at home. The doorbell echoes down the hallway, and as he opens the door, he sees Aya Hinata standing there, stepping into his room with no hesitation. As she lifts up her skirt to seduce him, he reflexively turns his back. What could possibly go wrong with a man and a woman in an enclosed space...?

episodes.title: You Have Been Selected
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to the consecutive weird dreams, Mamoru Sasaki has successfully built some trust between his homeroom students. He ends up recalling the dreams during class because they were so vivid, and reproaches himself. However, it's not just Sasaki who's been having the dream, but Mai Hoshino and Aya Hinata as well. The coming day, Hoshino runs up towards Sasaki on impulse as she sees him being friendly with another student, while Hinata witnesses the scene out the window.

episodes.title: Would You Like a Blond-Haired Gyaru?
episodes.synopsis: The students were getting excited about the coming school festival, only to have it cancelled due to the chairman's decision. Mamoru Sasaki, feeling disappointed and irritated at being useless, gets forcibly flung into the dream by the Guilty Hole that appears before him. In the dream, Mai Hoshino was waiting for him at school. She interrupts Sasaki's depressed talk and kisses him, leaning in and baring her breasts...

episodes.title: Would You Like to Select All?
episodes.synopsis: A moment of relief after successfully convincing the chairman cuts short for Mamoru Sasaki, when he ends up becoming the school festival's representative. Just when he falls asleep, more exhausted than ever, Guilty Hole notifies him that he has been selected. In the dream, the school festival was being held, and awaiting Sasaki were Mai Hoshino, Aya Hinata, and Makoto Hojo in maid outfits! As his three students gaze up at him with puppy-dog eyes, willingly serving him as a token of thanks for looking after them, Sasaki was finally able to enjoy his dream...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The different groups collide in Sapporo as a Jack the Ripper copycat is on the loose.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The chaotic battle at the Sapporo Beer factory begins.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
オストログの逃走を許した土方たちだが、都丹や有古の索敵能力を頼りに追跡を続けていた。追い込まれたオストログは、箱詰め作業場の藁苞に火を放ち再び逃亡。同じ頃、宇佐美に追い回されていた門倉は、ついに捕まり土方から託されていた刺青人皮を奪われてしまう。そこに尾形が姿を見せたことで、宇佐美と激しい戦闘に突入する。一方、杉元とはぐれて動力室に足を踏み入れたアシㇼパだが、そこに逃走中のオストログが現れ……。

　アシㇼパがアイヌだと気づいたオストログは、アイヌの伝承と聖母マリアを重ね、自らの犯行を正当化。それをアシㇼパに否定され凶器を向けるが、駆けつけた杉元によって始末された。時を同じくして、尾形と宇佐美の戦いも佳境を迎えていた。尾形の不意を突いた銃撃で重傷を負うも、鶴見中尉との合流を目指す宇佐美。だが尾形に背後から撃ち抜かれ、宇佐美は鶴見中尉の胸の中で死んでいった。その後、上エ地が煙突の上に現れ、自分のせいで暗号はもう解けないと挑発。しかし、各陣営は刺青をすべて集めなくても暗号は解けるとすでに気づいていた。煙突から転落した上エ地は、期待した反応を得られなかったことに絶望して最期を迎えるのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Botaro has his own ideas about what to do with the gold.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Asirpa is captured by Lt. Tsurumi, and learns the truth about the gold.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Asirpa learns of her father's dark past.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The final attempt to crack the code begins.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Years ago, Sugimoto was recruited for a certain operation in Tokyo...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The location of the gold is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The final search for the gold begins at Goryoukaku as the 7th Division closes in.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Lt. Tsurumi's assault on Goryoukaku begins in full force.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Tsurumi's forces make their way inside Goryoukaku, and Asirpa must decide to stay or flee.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Sugimoto and Asirpa flee Goryoukaku and board a nearby train.

episodes.title: Kahriman Of The Desert
episodes.synopsis: Keaton and the excavation team are left for dead in the Taklimakan Desert.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: Keaton, asked to recruit a former East German Olympic swimmer, but first Keaton must deal with the swimmer's depression and face off against a group of skinheads.

episodes.title: The Red Wind
episodes.synopsis: Razin left Russia to attend an air show in the UK, but after his two bodyguards are murdered, Keaton finds himself between Razin and a killer KGB agent.

episodes.title: A Message From Alexeyev
episodes.synopsis: While visiting a resort on a Spanish island, Keaton meets Sendel who reveals a tale of passion and betrayal between Russian agents and locals the Spanish Civil War 50 years ago.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Fruit
episodes.synopsis: Keaton crashes a party for the newest board member of the premiere accounting firm in the UK after he suspects the board member of murdering his way to the top!

episodes.title: The Highlands In Your Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Keaton attempts to rescue an artist forced to paint forgeries who has been held hostage in a house by his extreme shortsightedness and his shattered confidence.

episodes.title: The Scent Is The Key
episodes.synopsis: A man requests Keaton to investigate the untimely death of his friend who lacked a "scent of death."

episodes.title: The Back Street
episodes.synopsis: A reluctant Keaton believes he is handing enticement money to a woman on behalf of her father, but soon discovers quite a different story.

episodes.title: Devil Like An Angel
episodes.synopsis: Keaton searches for a Japanese art student in Italy only to discover the student has become involved with a terrorist group!

episodes.title: The Agate Color Of Time
episodes.synopsis: Keaton shares stories of his youth in Cornwall with his daughter, Yuriko.

episodes.title: Love In May
episodes.synopsis: Keaton's daughter becomes involved in a purse-snatching investigation in London while her father rests his broken leg in the hospital.

episodes.title: Blue Friday
episodes.synopsis: While Keaton chases after an elusive insurance beneficiary, his parter Daniel pursues a new beauty.

episodes.title: Interview Day
episodes.synopsis: Keaton, unsure about pursuing a career as an archaeologist, allows himself to be distracted by his father on his way to an interview at Tozai University.

episodes.title: Hunting Season (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis: Two knife murders in London drags Keaton into a chase tying the SAS to a vicious drug ring.

info.title: Colorful Stage! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing
info.synopsis: Ichika Hoshino sente una canzone di Miku mai sentita prima in un negozio di CD, e vede una Hatsune Miku diversa da quella che conosceva. Ichika chiama Miku che, sorpresa dalla voce, scompare dopo averne incrociato lo sguardo, per poi ricomparire sullo smartphone di Ichika; in quest'occasione, Miku le dice che vorrebbe raggiungere altre persone con le sue canzoni, ma che nonostante quanto canti, non riesce nel suo intento. Dopo aver visto Ichika toccare i cuori del pubblico con le sue performance per strada, Miku le chiede quindi aiuto.

info.title: Onegai AiPri
info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata su Konomi Inori, una studentessa del primo anno delle scuole medie che si è appena trasferita nella città di Onegai. Nella piazza della città, Konomi prega davanti alla statua della dea chiedendo di avere la possibilità di diventare una AiPri. Dopo aver pregato, incontra per caso la famosa AiPri Aoi Yumemiya e il suo misterioso peluche parlante di nome Fortu. Si scopre che Fortu è alla ricerca di una AiPri capace di realizzare il suo desiderio e, quando Konomi apre lo speciale “mirror pact” che Aoi le ha consegnato, ottiene il debutto come AiPri che aveva tanto desiderato.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: When Inori returns to Onegai Town, she makes a wish to the goddess statue in the town square. "Please give me a chance to become an AiPri!" Suddenly, Aoi, a popular AiPri, calls out to her. When they go to the AiPri shop together, Inori is asked by a little girl named Moko to choose a present for her older sister who is moving away. When Inori advises her to "give her something she 'likes' from the bottom of her heart," the stuffed animal Aoi was holding suddenly starts talking! The mysterious stuffed animal, who calls herself Fortune, and Aoi give Inori a Mirror Pact to become an AiPri and a Wish Jewel...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Inori begins her life in Onegai Town. When she enrolls in Onegai Middle School, Aoi is in the same class. After school, Aoi takes Inori to Meganee's cafe in Onegai Town. There, Fortune asks Inori to join the "Wish-Fulfilling Squad," which grants the wishes of the people of Onegai Town. The first person Fortune receives a wish from is Koharu, an upperclassman at the same school. What could Koharu's wish be...?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Aoi encounter a girl who is searching for something. She is Gumi Tomosaka, a classmate of theirs. She says she has lost a sticker that she cherished. It is a one-of-a-kind sticker that her younger brother and sister gave her for her birthday. Inori and Aoi are asked to help her find it. Inori and Aoi begin searching to fulfill Gumi's wish, but the sticker is nowhere to be found...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Aoi, on an errand for Meganee-san, arrive as requested. When they enter the Western-style confectionery shop they were looking for, they find Gumi there. Patisserie Tomosaka is Gumi's family business. After watching Inori and Aoi's live performance, Gumi tells them how amazing it is, and Inori asks, "Why don't you try AiPri?" But Gumi shakes her head, saying it's impossible. For the next few days, Gumi leaves school early after classes. In fact, she had been secretly training to become an Aipri without telling Inori and Aoi. Inori wants to see what she's doing...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Inori's grandfather is the mayor of Onegai Town. He prays to the goddess statue, saying, "I want to make this town a place full of smiles so that everyone can be even more cheerful than they are now." Hearing this, Inori gathers many people in the town square and proposes to hold the "Onegai Town AiPri Festival," or "AiPri Fest" for short. Then, on the day of the festival, not many people have gathered in the square. However, with the help of Koharu from the AiPri Club, people gradually begin to gather. Inori, Aoi, and Gumi are pumped up. The festival is about to begin!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Today, it's a sleepover at Aoi's house. Inori and Gumi are excited, but the serious Aoi says she wants to have a debriefing session about the AiPri Festival. The festival was a success, but she wants to be able to perform for even more people. Aoi tells the two of them about her aspirations. As a result of the debriefing, they come up with two goals: "to fill the plaza with customers" and "to try a new type of live performance." After dinner, Aoi's older sister, Wakaba, comes home. Wakaba, who is in the track and field club, is happy because she ran with her friends and set a new record. Hearing this, Gumi says she wants to see Inori and Aoi's live performance...

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The Wish-Fulfilling Team received two requests. The first was from Satsuki. She was worried because she had injured herself during club practice, but her friends were saying it was "nothing serious." The other was from Aoi's older sister, Wakaba. She was worried because she wasn't in good form, even though a track and field competition was coming up. Gumi decided to support Satsuki, while Aoi and Inori decided to support Wakaba. The Wish-Fulfilling Team worked hard to fulfill both of their wishes, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Inori and the others thank Olivia, the student council president, for helping to make the AiPri Festival a success. However, Olivia seems very busy with the student council's "Flower Planting Campaign." Gumi brings Olivia some baked goods to cheer her up as she works hard alone. Olivia became student council president at someone's request. She's also working hard on the "Flower Planting Campaign" all by herself, thinking of everyone. But deep down, she wishes she could have fun doing it with everyone. When Gumi hears this, she...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Olivia visits the AiPri Shop alone. Seeing how much Olivia knows about AiPri's, Mega-nee asks her, "Do you want to become an Aipri?" Just then, Inori and the Wish-Fulfilling Team, along with Koharu, arrive at the shop. Olivia quickly leaves the shop as if she was running away. Koharu had wanted to talk to Olivia about the next AiPri Festival. Meanwhile, Olivia still worries about lying to Koharu, saying that she didn't know much about AiPris, even though she actually wanted to become one. At that moment, a request arrives from Koharu to Inori and the others: "I want courage..."

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Something is wrong with Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is found in the schoolyard with lots of bread. This morning, Olivia's portion of bread was gone. Worried, Olivia begins searching for Leon.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Inori's birthday is fast approaching. Inori invites Aoi and the others to her birthday party. She sets off to find a venue. Aoi, Gumi, and Olivia visit Inori's grandparents to give her a present. As they try to find out what Inori likes, Aoi and the others learn that every time Inori returns to Onegai Town, she prays to the goddess's statue, "May I always be good friends with my best friends." Determined to make it the best birthday party ever for Inori, Aoi and the others are excited. However, on the day of the party, the weather is unfortunately rainy...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Koharu wants Olivia's live performance to be the main event of the upcoming second AiPri Festival. Gumi encourages her to do it, but Olivia firmly refuses, saying she's not confident. Both girls are dejected. Inori and Aoi, who received Koharu's wish that they make up, perform a duo live show! Just as Olivia receives their feelings, her brother Aran appears. After receiving some great advice from him, Olivia runs off to Gumi...

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The second annual AiPri Festival is finally about to begin. Even more people have gathered than last time, and Inori is excited and in high spirits. However, Olivia is trembling with nervousness. This is contagious, and Aoi and the others start shivering as well. Just then, Wakaba, Koharu, Satsuki, Leon, Moko, Gam, Choco, and Ho come to cheer them on. Regaining her composure, Olivia goes out onto the stage. Then, the Inori and Aoi duo takes the stage, and the festival becomes a huge success. However, Atami Nana watches the whole scene with a serious expression...

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: The second AiPri Festival has ended, and the Wish-Fulfilling Squad is full of energy with Aoi as their new leader. Then, a wish arrives from Kanata, a student at High Sense Academy. Kanata says she entered High Sense Academy with the dream of becoming a fashion designer, but has now given up. She had prayed to the statue of the goddess, "May I find my true dream." Just then, Atami Nana, also from High Sense Academy, appears. Nana urges Kanata, "Don't rely on anyone, figure it out on your own." Hearing this, Gumi tries to find Kanata's "true dream"...

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: From the Atami family mansion, figures can be seen gazing out at Onegai Town... It's Atami Nana, her brother Sango, and their butler, Hyozan. Sango asks, "Nana, if you become an AiPri, do you think you can grant someone's wish?" Nana decides to become an AiPri. At the same time, Shioki and Koike from the Onegai Middle School student council are making a wish to the goddess. They are lamenting that they can't get their hands on a watermelon and won't be able to make everyone happy during their summer off-campus volunteer activity. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer them up. Just as Shioki and Koike regain their motivation, Nana appears before them...

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Inori and her friends are looking forward to summer vacation. Nana has performed many live shows, but has yet to successfully perform a Buzzrium Change. Just then, a request arrives. It's from Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is depressed because he has angered his friend Manabu by not getting a perfect score on a test. Gumi performs a live show to help them make up. Nana watches them and tries to achieve a Buzzrium Change with her own passion...

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation has begun. On her way to Meganee's cafe, Inori hears a rumor from Moko that there's a ghost on the beach. Inori suggests that the Wishing Squad go and look for it. However, Aoi refuses, saying she has summer homework to do. Nana then joins them and asks Aoi, the leader, "What do you want to do with the Wishing Squad from now on?" Aoi is troubled and can't answer immediately. Just then, they spot a ghost on the beach! Or so they think, but it turns out to be a dejected Fumika...

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Gamu and Choco want to make the next AiPri Festival a success, so they start building a huge sandcastle on the beach. Just as it's almost finished, they go home to get the flag they'll put on top. When they return to the beach with Gumi, they find the sandcastle has been swallowed by the waves and collapsed. Dejected, Gamu and Choco end up fighting. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer up Choco. Meanwhile, Emma appears before Gamu, who has made a wish: "I hope I can build a sandcastle with Choco again." It turns out that Emma was the one who advised him to make the wish. What exactly is her aim...?

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: After seeing Nana's passionate live performance, Megane's older sister was filled with emotion and embarked on a three-day summer vacation. During that time, Nana's butler, Hyozan, was put in charge of acting store manager. Inori and the others also decided to help out at the store. Thanks to Nana's publicity, many customers came, and the Wish-Fulfilling Team was full of energy. --And then Shioki arrived. Shioki, along with Ema, ​​belongs to the "Wish Town Mystery Research Society." She had wished to see the "Midsummer Blue Jewel," which is said to be only visible during the summer. Taking her wish to heart, Ema took to the stage for the live performance.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: The 3rd AiPri Festival is fast approaching. The day before, Sango's "High-Sense Festival" will be held. It seems to be a variety show featuring talk segments, games, and prize giveaways, with the super-popular talent "Tate Goto" making an appearance. Nana suggests that she perform the final live show of the AiPri Festival to liven up the event. However, Olivia argues that Nana's performance is only worthy of being at the top. The two girls' relationship becomes strained... Nana challenges Olivia to a live show showdown...

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: The town of Onegai, a seaside town that sparkles and shines in the sunlight. In the town square stands a statue of a goddess, and it is said that if you make a wish to the goddess, that wish will come true. Inori and Aoi met in front of that statue. That was the beginning of the miracles that would unfold in Onegai Town. This special episode looks back on the many events that have occurred since Inori and Aoi met, together with Forchu.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: The day of the showdown between the AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival has arrived. The High-Sense Festival is buzzing with excitement thanks to Tate Goto's sweet poetry. But then, as if to drown out the excitement, Nana appears, instantly raising the energy of the AiPri Festival. Then, Inori and Aoi appear. Their duo performance sends the audience into a frenzy. This is followed by Emma's solo, and then a duet by Aoi and Gumi. The AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival are neck and neck in terms of excitement so far. Which one will win?!

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is over and second semester begins. Nana came to Onegai Junior High School where Inori and her friends were.. Nana asks her to find Emma, ​​who is also a student at the Hisense Academy she attends.. When I looked into it, it appears that he has submitted a transfer notification.. Nana forms the Onegai Detective Team with Inori and Aoi to investigate Emma's whereabouts.. During Gumi and Oribia duo live, Nana and her friends discover Emma carrying a large bag.. Emma said, "Please, I have to leave town.".

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Inori's friend, Mai-chan, has come to Onegai Town. Inori gives her a tour of Onegai Town. Mai-chan, a huge fan of AiPri, is thrilled to meet Inori, Olivia, Gumi, Emma, ​​Nana, and Aoi. She is also very happy to see Nana and Emma perform live. Another thing she wanted to do in Onegai Town was to meet her pen pal, Ayaka-chan. Inori and the others begin searching for her together. However, they discover that the picture book store where Ayaka was supposed to live moved a week ago...

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Rumors spread that a girl ghost haunts AiPriverse. Emma, ​​a member of the "Mystery Research Club," is fascinated by ghosts. Just then, a request arrives from AiPriverse. Inori and the others immediately head to I-Priverse. There, they meet the three members of the AiPri Club: Riori, Azumin, and Kyoka. Riori and the others say that the request was made by a ghost. Just then, the rumored girl appears before the Wish Granting Team!? And what is the ghost's request...?

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Inori prays to the statue of the goddess, "Please let me meet the goddess soon." To make the "miracle of the goddess" happen, they must start walking towards a new dream. To do that, Inori and the others realize they need to fulfill many more wishes and begin special training. Nana comes up with ideas like taiyaki-themed outfits and poetry, but Gumi objects, saying, "I think something's not right." Their opinions clash, and the two girls fall apart. Left alone, Inori feels anxious. To make matters worse, she receives news that her grandfather has been hospitalized...

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: To perform a miracle, they must overcome the "Goddess's Trial." The team of three, Inori, Gumi, and Nana, has decided on the name "Smile Heart" and is full of enthusiasm.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Autumn is the season for art. An art festival is being held at the Wish Square, and it's a huge success. Inori, Gumi, and Nana are enjoying themselves. However, Aoi, Olivia, and Emma are anxious to make their trio live performance a success as soon as possible. Emma and the others know their own personalities, that they are too cautious and can't act quickly. They decide to think together about what the three of them need right now. But they can't seem to find an answer. Just then, Aoi and the others receive a request from Shioki and Koike, who are participating in the art festival...

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Emma wants to perform the "Goddess's Miracle," but feels she still isn't trying hard enough. Meanwhile, Inori wants to become closer to Emma, ​​who, along with Aoi and the other girl, has deepened their bond and successfully held a Pure Heart live performance. Inori immediately goes to see Emma. Emma is anxious because she needs to collect the Wish Prisms. However, she is moved by Inori's enthusiastic desire to "get to know Emma better!" and the two end up playing together...

info.title: The Ghost in the Shell
info.synopsis: Nell'anno 2029, Niihama City è una metropoli tecnologicamente avanzata dove i cittadini possono sostituire i propri arti con parti robotiche, e la Sezione 9 della Pubblica Sicurezza combatte corruzione, terrorismo e altre minacce nate dalla globalizzazione. La Maggiore Motoko Kusanagi guida un caso che coinvolge un misterioso hacker noto come il "Puppet Master", che lascia dietro di sé vittime private dei ricordi e possiede un corpo quasi interamente robotico dai poteri straordinari. Mentre Motoko segue le tracce del criminale, l'ingerenza di altre parti in causa, tra cui la Sezione 6, rivela la natura estremamente complessa del caso, e riflettendo sul senso della propria esistenza la Maggiore capisce presto che l'unico in grado di darle risposte è proprio il Puppet Master.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 01: PROLOGUE + SUPER SPARTAN i
episodes.synopsis: Durante un blitz scattato nel corso di un incontro con un delegato straniero che secondo Daisuke Aramaki della Sicurezza Pubblica potrebbe vedere coinvolte attività criminali e di corruzione, Aramaki conosce un misterioso cyborg, Motoko Kusanagi, che gli propone di formare una nuova unità speciale per il Ministero degli Interni. Aramaki chiede dunque a Kusanagi di avviare un'indagine.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 02: SUPER SPARTAN ii + JUNK JUNGLE i
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi e la sua squadra iniziano a lavorare come Squadra mobile corazzata dopo essere stati scelti da Aramaki. A un certo punto, il cyber-brain dell'interprete del Ministro degli Esteri viene infettato da un virus. Aramaki sente che il colonnello Males, che vive in esilio nel Paese, sta cercando di interferire in un incontro segreto. Ordina così a Kusanagi di trovare il colpevole.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 03: JUNK JUNGLE ii + MEGATECH MACHINE i + ii
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi e Togusa prendono in custodia il sospettato dopo uno sfrenato inseguimento nei loro Fuchikoma. Intanto, Aramaki e Bato sorvegliano il colonnello Males che riceve una visita che potrebbe essere del Marionettista, l'hacker che ha diffuso il virus su suo ordine.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 04: ROBOT RONDO
episodes.synopsis: Alcuni robot promozionali attaccano gli esseri umani. La squadra di Kusanagi raduna i robot dello stesso modello e scopre che hanno qualcosa in comune. Bato e Togusa sono diretti alla Hanka dove vengono costruiti per scoprire chi è la mente dietro a queste aggressioni.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 05: PHANTOM FUND
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi e la sua squadra raggiungono l'Estremo Nord per sorvegliare un cyborg da combattimento di nome Koil Klasnov. Per scoprire cosa vuole Koil e cosa c'è dietro l'espansione della fabbrica sotterranea della Sagawa, Kusanagi si infiltra nei suoi uffici mentre Bato e gli altri si infiltrano nella fabbrica stessa.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 06: DUMB BARTER
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi e il suo compagno vengono portati di corsa in ospedale dopo un'aggressione improvvisa. Sospettano che si tratti di Toru Soma, un terrorista con cui Kusanagi ha dei trascorsi. Kusanagi e Togusa lasciano l'ospedale e dopo un inseguimento si ritrovano a combattere contro un gruppo armato in una fabbrica abbandonata.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 07: BYE BYE CLAY
episodes.synopsis: Un robot fuggito dalla Megatech viene preso in custodia dalla Sezione 9 che scopre che al suo interno si nasconde il Marionettista. Il Marionettista annuncia alla squadra di Aramaki di essere "una forma di vita nata spontaneamente nel mare dell'informatica". Poco dopo aver chiesto asilo politico, viene rubato.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 08: INTERMISSION + BRAIN DRAIN i
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi riprende conoscenza dopo essersi infiltrata nel Marionettista. Anche se ormai è chiaro ciò che è successo, di tanto in tanto Kusanagi ne percepisce la presenza. La squadra fa una retata su una barca usata da una cellula terroristica e Kusanagi ne uccide per sbaglio il leader.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 09: BRAIN DRAIN ii
episodes.synopsis: Qualcuno fa trapelare le immagini dell'incidente della retata ai media e Kusanagi viene accusata di aver ucciso il terrorista a sangue freddo. Kusanagi sospetta che i servizi segreti di Ghorantl tirino le fila e così indaga da sola, ma viene processata.

episodes.title: EPISODIO 10: BRAIN DRAIN ⅲ + GHOST COAST + EPILOGO
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi perde il suo corpo artificiale dopo che le sparano e fugge con Bato solo con il suo cervello. Vanno nel rifugio di Bato per trovarle un nuovo corpo, ma il Marionettista, che si presumeva distrutto, trova il modo di accedere a Kusanagi.

info.title: Babel II: Beyond Infinity
info.synopsis: Adattamento animato del 2001 del manga di Mitsuteru Yokoyama. Durante l'epoca babilonese un extraterrestre venuto dallo spazio, a causa di un'avaria scende sulla Terra. Decide di costruire una torre con all'interno una nuova astronave per fare ritorno a casa,ma fallisce e lascia l'eredita'del suo sapere ai suoi futuri discendenti. Il discendente dell'extraterrestre è un ragazzo di nome Koichi.

info.title: Romelia War Chronicle
info.synopsis: "Contessa Romelia. Rompo il nostro fidanzamento". Queste furono le prime parole del principe Henri subito dopo aver sconfitto il Re dei Demoni. Al suo fianco c'erano la santa Elizabeth, la saggia Ekaterina e la spadaccina orientale Lu Hime... tutte quante la puntano con aria accusatrice definendola "inutile". Ma Henri e le sue compagne non sapevano che Romelia possedeva un potere miracoloso chiamato "Grazia", in grado di conferire fortuna a chi la circonda. Nonostante l'abbandono del fidanzato e delle sue compagne, Romelia non si è arresa. La sua terra natale è ancora infestata dalle forze del Re dei Demoni e molte persone sono tenute prigioniere e utilizzate come schiavi. Per salvarle la ragazza si è imbarcata in una missione piena di difficoltà: per prima cosa non aveva un esercito con cui combattere, non aveva nessun guaritore che potesse curare le ferite e le mancavano i fondi per finanziare tutto. Ma Romelia è determinata a risolvere ogni problema, non importa se dovrà usare le maniere forti. Risorgendo dalle ceneri, una nobildonna decaduta si erge per salvare l'umanità!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Romelia heads to her home after her betrothal to the prince is broken.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Romelia moves to an isolated fortress in the countryside and begins to enact her plans.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Romelia's men fight their first battle.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Ray struggles with his role as Romelia's bodyguard in her new unit.
